Generate a 3D model of an octopus chef at a ramen booth

Make it in Blender, working in the current directory.
- A Blender 5 instance is running for you with no window (background mode). Use it through the `blender`
  MCP tools: run Python (`bpy`) with execute_blender_code, and look things up with the API and manual
  search tools. Blender's working directory is the current directory. The scene starts as Blender's
  default one (a cube, a camera and a light).
- There is no window to screenshot. To check your work, render it to an image file and look at the image
  (render_thumbnail_to_path, render_viewport_to_path, or a render of the scene camera to a file).
  Keep renders quick: a single tool call may take at most 5 minutes.
- Build it in Blender itself; don't write the model or the images any other way.
- Save the finished result in ./output/ (only what is in ./output/ is published):
  - the model or scene as one .glb file (glTF binary), shown on the site in an interactive 3D viewer:
    `bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=..., export_format='GLB')`, without Draco or meshopt
    compression, at most 15 MB;
  - one or more final renders as .png or .jpg, at most 2 MB each, from camera angles you choose.
  At most 8 files in all.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.15.0 (standard library only), node 26.12.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything (no asset
  libraries or add-ons).
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

import bpy, math, os
from mathutils import Vector

# clear
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
for d in (bpy.data.meshes, bpy.data.curves, bpy.data.cameras, bpy.data.lights):
    pass

def mat(name, color, rough=0.6, metal=0.0):
    m=bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes=True
    bsdf=m.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(*color,1)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=rough
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=metal
    return m

M={
 'octo': mat("Octopus",(0.55,0.25,0.75),0.45),
 'octo_light': mat("OctoLight",(0.85,0.55,0.95),0.5),
 'white': mat("White",(0.95,0.95,0.93),0.6),
 'black': mat("Black",(0.02,0.02,0.03),0.3),
 'red': mat("Red",(0.85,0.08,0.08),0.5),
 'wood': mat("Wood",(0.45,0.25,0.12),0.8),
 'wood_dark': mat("WoodDark",(0.25,0.12,0.06),0.85),
 'teal': mat("Teal",(0.05,0.55,0.55),0.6),
 'cream': mat("Cream",(0.95,0.85,0.65),0.7),
 'bowl': mat("BowlBlue",(0.1,0.25,0.75),0.3),
 'broth': mat("Broth",(0.95,0.65,0.25),0.4),
 'noodle': mat("Noodle",(0.98,0.85,0.45),0.6),
 'green': mat("Green",(0.15,0.65,0.2),0.6),
 'pink': mat("Pink",(1.0,0.55,0.6),0.5),
 'floor': mat("Floor",(0.2,0.18,0.22),0.9),
 'gold': mat("Gold",(1.0,0.75,0.2),0.35,0.6),
}

def assign(obj, material):
    obj.data.materials.append(material)

def cube(name, loc, scale, material, bevel=0.0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
    if bevel:
        mod=o.modifiers.new("bev","BEVEL"); mod.width=bevel; mod.segments=3
    assign(o, material); return o

def sphere(name, loc, scale, material):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(location=loc, segments=32, ring_count=16)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True)
    assign(o, material)
    # smooth
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    return o

def cyl(name, loc, radius, depth, material, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(location=loc, radius=radius, depth=depth, vertices=32, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; assign(o, material); return o

def cone(name, loc, r1, r2, depth, material, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(location=loc, radius1=r1, radius2=r2, depth=depth, vertices=32, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; assign(o, material); return o

def torus(name, loc, major, minor, material, rot=(0,0,0), scale=(1,1,1)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(location=loc, major_radius=major, minor_radius=minor, major_segments=32, minor_segments=12, rotation=rot)
    o=bpy.context.active_object; o.name=name; o.scale=scale; assign(o, material); return o

# Floor
cube("Floor",(0,0,-0.05),(4.5,3.5,0.05),M['floor'])

# Booth: counter
cube("CounterFront",(0,0.9,0.6),(2.6,0.15,0.6),M['wood'])
cube("CounterTop",(0,0.75,1.25),(2.7,0.5,0.08),M['wood_dark'],0.02)
cube("CounterSideL",(-2.55,0.9,0.6),(0.12,0.9,0.6),M['wood'])
cube("CounterSideR",(2.55,0.9,0.6),(0.12,0.9,0.6),M['wood'])
# noren curtain panels (teal fabric strips hanging front top of counter? Actually front decoration)
for i,x in enumerate([-1.8,-0.9,0,0.9,1.8]):
    cube(f"NorenFront{i}",(x,1.06,1.05),(0.42,0.02,0.18),M['teal'] if i%2==0 else M['red'])

# Posts and roof
for x in [-2.6,2.6]:
    cyl(f"Post{x}",(x,-0.2,1.8),0.09,3.6,M['wood_dark'])
# roof
cube("Roof",(0,-0.2,3.75),(3.0,1.6,0.12),M['red'],0.03)
cube("RoofRidge",(0,-0.2,3.95),(3.05,0.18,0.12),M['wood_dark'])
# hanging noren under roof
for i,x in enumerate([-2.0,-1.0,0,1.0,2.0]):
    cube(f"Noren{i}",(x,-0.55,3.15),(0.45,0.03,0.55),M['teal'])
# sign board
cube("Sign",(0,-0.68,3.35),(1.4,0.05,0.35),M['cream'])
# lanterns
for x in [-2.3,2.3]:
    sphere(f"Lantern{x}",(x,-0.7,2.9),(0.28,0.28,0.34),M['red'])
    cyl(f"LanternCap{x}",(x,-0.7,3.28),0.12,0.08,M['gold'])
    cyl(f"LanternString{x}",(x,-0.7,3.5),0.02,0.4,M['black'])

# stools in front
for x in [-1.6,0,1.6]:
    cyl(f"StoolSeat{x}",(x,1.9,0.65),0.32,0.1,M['red'])
    cyl(f"StoolLeg{x}",(x,1.9,0.3),0.07,0.6,M['wood_dark'])

# --- Octopus chef behind counter ---
# body/head mantle
sphere("OctoHead",(0,0.15,2.0),(0.75,0.65,0.85),M['octo'])
sphere("OctoBelly",(0,0.55,1.45),(0.55,0.3,0.45),M['octo_light'])
# eyes
for x in [-0.28,0.28]:
    sphere(f"EyeWhite{x}",(x,0.78,2.25),(0.16,0.08,0.18),M['white'])
    sphere(f"EyePupil{x}",(x,0.85,2.28),(0.08,0.04,0.09),M['black'])
    sphere(f"EyeGlint{x}",(x-0.03,0.88,2.38),(0.03,0.02,0.03),M['white'])
# cheeks
for x in [-0.5,0.5]:
    sphere(f"Cheek{x}",(x,0.72,1.95),(0.12,0.04,0.09),M['pink'])
# mouth smile - small torus arc
torus("Mouth",(0,0.82,1.95),0.12,0.025,M['black'],rot=(math.radians(20),0,math.radians(180)),scale=(1,1,0.6))
# chef hat
cyl("HatBand",(0,0.15,2.85),0.58,0.35,M['white'])
sphere("HatTop",(0,0.15,3.15),(0.62,0.58,0.35),M['white'])
sphere("HatPuffL",(-0.3,0.15,3.2),(0.3,0.28,0.25),M['white'])
sphere("HatPuffR",(0.3,0.15,3.2),(0.3,0.28,0.25),M['white'])
# red hachimaki? add band accent below hat
torus("HatTrim",(0,0.15,2.68),0.58,0.04,M['red'],rot=(math.radians(90),0,0))

# tentacles: 8 - curved using multiple spheres / use bezier tube
def tentacle(name, base, points, radius=0.14):
    cu=bpy.data.curves.new(name,'CURVE'); cu.dimensions='3D'; cu.resolution_u=2
    cu.bevel_depth=radius; cu.bevel_resolution=3
    sp=cu.splines.new('BEZIER'); sp.bezier_points.add(len(points)-1)
    for bp,co in zip(sp.bezier_points, points):
        bp.co=co; bp.handle_left_type='AUTO'; bp.handle_right_type='AUTO'
    ob=bpy.data.objects.new(name,cu); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.data.materials.append(M['octo'])
    # tip sphere
    sphere(name+"Tip", points[-1], (radius*0.9,)*3, M['octo_light'])
    return ob

# front tentacles over counter holding things
tentacle("TentL1", (0,0,0), [(-0.5,0.3,1.3),(-0.9,0.6,1.2),(-1.3,0.8,1.35),(-1.5,0.85,1.5)])
tentacle("TentR1", (0,0,0), [(0.5,0.3,1.3),(0.9,0.6,1.2),(1.3,0.8,1.35),(1.5,0.85,1.5)])
tentacle("TentL2", (0,0,0), [(-0.6,0.2,1.2),(-1.1,0.3,1.0),(-1.7,0.5,1.3),(-2.0,0.6,1.6)])
tentacle("TentR2", (0,0,0), [(0.6,0.2,1.2),(1.1,0.3,1.0),(1.7,0.5,1.3),(2.0,0.6,1.6)])
tentacle("TentL3", (0,0,0), [(-0.4,-0.2,1.2),(-0.8,-0.4,0.8),(-1.0,-0.5,0.4)])
tentacle("TentR3", (0,0,0), [(0.4,-0.2,1.2),(0.8,-0.4,0.8),(1.0,-0.5,0.4)])
tentacle("TentL4", (0,0,0), [(-0.2,0.0,1.15),(-0.35,0.7,1.05),(-0.2,1.0,1.4)])
tentacle("TentR4", (0,0,0), [(0.2,0.0,1.15),(0.45,0.55,1.1),(0.7,0.75,1.45)])

# Ramen bowl in front tentacles center on counter
cyl("Bowl", (0,0.85,1.38), 0.38, 0.22, M['bowl'])
cyl("BowlFoot",(0,0.85,1.24),0.2,0.06,M['bowl'])
torus("BowlRim",(0,0.85,1.49),0.38,0.03,M['white'],rot=(math.radians(90),0,0))
cyl("Broth",(0,0.85,1.49),0.35,0.03,M['broth'])
# noodle swirls
for i,(x,y) in enumerate([(-0.12,0.75),(0.1,0.9),(0,0.82)]):
    torus(f"Noodle{i}",(x,y,1.52),0.11,0.03,M['noodle'],rot=(math.radians(90),0,0))
# egg, narutomaki, green onion
sphere("Egg",( -0.18,0.95,1.55),(0.1,0.1,0.05),M['white'])
sphere("Yolk",(-0.18,0.95,1.58),(0.05,0.05,0.03),M['gold'])
cyl("Naruto",(0.2,0.75,1.53),0.07,0.03,M['pink'],rot=(math.radians(90),0,0))
for i in range(6):
    import random
    cyl(f"Scallion{i}",(-0.05+i*0.04,0.8+(i%3)*0.05,1.54),0.02,0.02,M['green'])

# chopsticks held by right tentacle
cyl("Chop1",(0.7,0.75,1.7),0.02,0.6,M['wood'],rot=(math.radians(70),0,math.radians(20)))
cyl("Chop2",(0.78,0.78,1.68),0.02,0.6,M['wood'],rot=(math.radians(70),0,math.radians(25)))
# ladle in left
cyl("LadleHandle",(-1.5,0.85,1.75),0.025,0.5,M['gold'],rot=(math.radians(60),0,0))
sphere("LadleCup",(-1.5,0.85,1.55),(0.11,0.11,0.06),M['gold'])

# second small bowl on counter left, pot right
cyl("Bowl2",(-1.7,0.6,1.35),0.3,0.18,M['red'])
cyl("Broth2",(-1.7,0.6,1.44),0.27,0.02,M['broth'])
cyl("Pot",(1.9,0.5,1.5),0.35,0.45,M['black'])
cyl("PotLid",(1.9,0.5,1.75),0.36,0.05,M['gold'])
sphere("PotKnob",(1.9,0.5,1.82),(0.07,)*3,M['wood_dark'])
# steam curls (white translucent spheres)
for i,(x,y,z,s) in enumerate([(1.9,0.5,2.0,0.1),(1.85,0.5,2.25,0.13),(1.95,0.5,2.5,0.09),(0,0.85,1.75,0.08),(0.05,0.85,1.95,0.11)]):
    o=sphere(f"Steam{i}",(x,y,z),(s,s*1.3,s),M['white'])
    # transparency
    # keep opaque soft

# menu board side
cube("Menu",( -2.4,-0.6,2.0),(0.5,0.04,0.7),M['cream'])
for i in range(3):
    cube(f"MenuLine{i}",(-2.4,-0.63,2.3-i*0.25),(0.35,0.01,0.04),M['red'])

result={"objects": len(bpy.data.objects)}

import bpy, math, os
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)
scene=bpy.context.scene
scene.render.engine='BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT'
scene.render.resolution_x=900; scene.render.resolution_y=700
scene.render.resolution_percentage=100
scene.world=bpy.data.worlds.new("W") if not scene.world else scene.world
scene.world.use_nodes=True
scene.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[0].default_value=(0.08,0.07,0.12,1)
scene.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[1].default_value=0.6

def look_at(obj, target):
    import mathutils
    obj.rotation_euler=(mathutils.Vector(target)-obj.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()

# camera
cam_data=bpy.data.cameras.new("Cam"); cam=bpy.data.objects.new("Camera",cam_data)
bpy.context.collection.objects.link(cam); scene.camera=cam
cam.location=(5.5,7.5,3.8); look_at(cam,(0,0.3,1.4)); cam_data.lens=38

# lights
def add_light(name, typ, loc, energy, size=3):
    d=bpy.data.lights.new(name,typ); d.energy=energy
    if hasattr(d,'shadow_soft_size'): d.shadow_soft_size=size
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,d); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o); o.location=loc; return o
key=add_light("Key",'AREA',(4,5,6),800,4); look_at(key,(0,0,1))
fill=add_light("Fill",'AREA',(-5,3,4),300,4); look_at(fill,(0,0,1))
warm=add_light("Warm",'POINT',(0,-1,3),200); warm.data.color=(1,0.7,0.4)

scene.render.filepath=os.path.abspath("output/render_front.png")
bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)

# second angle
cam.location=(-5,6.5,3.0); look_at(cam,(0,0.3,1.3))
scene.render.filepath=os.path.abspath("output/render_angle.png")
bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)

# back to hero
cam.location=(4.2,6.8,3.2); look_at(cam,(0,0.3,1.4))
scene.camera=cam
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=os.path.abspath("output/octopus_ramen.blend"))
bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=os.path.abspath("output/octopus_ramen.glb"), export_format='GLB', export_apply=True)
import os as o
result={f: o.path.getsize("output/"+f) for f in o.listdir("output")}
